{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_df = sales_df[(sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Compute the fraction of converted customers
n_total = len(filtered_df)
n_converted = filtered_df['converted'].sum()
fraction_converted = n_converted / n_total

# Print the result
print(f'Total NEW customers from PAID SEARCH: {n_total}')
print(f'Converted: {n_converted}')
print(f'Fraction converted: {fraction_converted}')"}
